column2: The Hydra has been found, and with it, the reason why the Mass Pheromone Emitter failed to lure it out. The creature's powerful instincts drive it to guard a massive lair containing millions of eggs. Once a perimeter around the nest has been established, the Hercules Program will finally reach its climax with the capture of the Hydra.
